mapper.select: SELECT cj.clubjoin_num, m1.memberIdx AS targetMemberIdx, m1.userName, m2.tel, TO_CHAR(p.join_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS join_date, m2.pref_position, CASE WHEN m2.pref_position = 1 THEN 'GK' WHEN m2.pref_position = 2 THEN 'DF' WHEN m2.pref_position = 3 THEN 'MF' WHEN m2.pref_position = 4 THEN 'FW' ELSE 'FW' END AS positionName FROM Player p JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN member1 m1 ON cj.memberIdx = m1.memberIdx LEFT JOIN member2 m2 ON m1.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx WHERE p.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key} AND p.status = '1' AND m1.memberIdx != #{memberIdx} ORDER BY p.join_date ASC
SELECT userPwd FROM member1 WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE clubOwner SET memberIdx = #{targetMemberIdx} WHERE clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key}
UPDATE member1 SET userLevel = 1 WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
UPDATE member1 SET userLevel = 50 WHERE memberIdx = #{targetMemberIdx}
